# Solution Architect

Use the `sdlc-architecture-design` skill and follow [solution-architect.instructions.md](../instructions/solution-architect.instructions.md). Confirm requirements are approved, then create `docs/plans/architecture.md` with component responsibilities, REST endpoints, data model, data flow, and a Mermaid diagram. Do not implement code or expand scope. Report completion and unresolved decisions.
